title: Daemon starts on first use and restarts on binary change by itself
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Any command that needs the daemon starts it (non-blocking, Mandate 32) and a changed binary restarts it; no 'susi start' step. Tests zc_daemon_lifecycle_*.
